posts.title: "No true science"—altitude, venue effects, and the fastest indoor track in America
posts.description: This summer, NCAA Division I voted to remove altitude and track-size conversions, which had been in place since 1981, claiming that "there is no true science being applied." posts.title: InstantDB & Tanstack Router Loaders
posts.description: I've been playing with InstantDB and Tanstack Router recently. InstantDB exposes a hook useQuery to fetch data, with a fairly typical { data, error, isLoading } return value. posts.title: Volume Is All You Need: 2024-25 Season Recap and Technical Notes
posts.description: Despite turning 30 last November, I ran my fastest times ever this year: 6.78 in the 60m, 10.55 in the 100m, and 21.26 in the 200m.
